inventory: RedOS Arsenal CE 1.0 partially inspected VM
inventory_limit: 147 menu entries plus 74 additional normalized tools/collections/commands. About 4.28 GiB of VDI data was not recovered after the official download hit its quota; this is not a complete VM SBOM.
version_limit: Matches tool/source identities; new pins do not claim byte-for-byte equality with VM-installed versions.

rows.name: crt.sh upit preko curl-a
rows.note: curl je katalogizovan; crt.sh je spoljašnji servis korišćen u prečici.

rows.name: dnsenum
rows.note: Kali/Fedora-maintained dnsenum fork. README suggests an HTTP curl-to-Perl installer; Makefile install can install CPAN dependencies. Neither is run by this collection.

rows.name: exiftool
rows.note: Pinned upstream Perl application and module files captured; metadata parsing and user-supplied configuration/expression features are outside a sandbox boundary.

rows.name: gowitness
rows.note: Headless browser screenshot tool. Reviewed root command, runner and build files; it acts on supplied websites and requires a browser at execution time.

rows.name: knockpy
rows.note: Reviewed packaging and CLI/config entrypoints. Passive sources can receive queried domains; optional API keys are stored in the tool configuration.

rows.name: puredns
rows.note: DNS wrapper around an external massdns executable. No dependency installer is invoked by the collection.

rows.name: wapiti
rows.note: Reviewed package metadata and CLI entrypoint. Scanner can update upstream fingerprint data; targets, optional callback endpoints and dependencies require execution-time review.

rows.name: wfuzz
rows.note: Packaging reads local version/README and temporarily creates a documentation symlink. CLI and request-fuzzing entrypoints captured; no install performed.

rows.name: WPScan
rows.note: Original WPScan source. Custom WPScan Public Source License has commercial conditions. Optional vulnerability API/database requests are expected application behavior.

rows.name: arjun
rows.note: HTTP parameter scanner; package setup imports its local version module. No installer or target requests executed.

rows.name: crlfuzz
rows.note: Reviewed Go CLI and release installer. README curl-to-shell shortcut downloads release binaries; collection uses pinned source instead of that installer.

rows.name: dirsearch
rows.note: Reviewed Python packaging/entrypoint and native build metadata. Dockerfile invokes a remote Rust installer; not used by the source fetcher.

rows.name: hydra
rows.note: Official THC authentication assessment source; reviewed configure and C entrypoint. Authentication attempts are an intentional capability, not proof of an upstream implant.

rows.name: medusa
rows.note: Foofus network authentication tool. This is distinct from Ch0pin/medusa already present for mobile instrumentation.

rows.name: adidnsdump
rows.note: Reviewed setup and DNS-dumping module. Credentials are used for the explicitly selected AD/DNS endpoint.

rows.name: evil-winrm (Python)
rows.note: Reviewed setup, Python entrypoint and optional MCP server. MCP is opt-in and defaults to 127.0.0.1; remote command execution/file transfer are documented functions.

rows.name: Responder
rows.note: Intentional name-resolution poisoning and authentication capture. Reviewed CLI, settings and configuration; certificate generation and local network inspection occur when the tool runs.

rows.name: LinEnum
rows.note: Enumeration intentionally reads sensitive local configuration and readable password/hash files. Exported reports can contain secrets; no hidden remote destination was identified in this scoped inspection.

rows.name: cewl
rows.note: Website-derived wordlist generator; reviewed Ruby entrypoint and Gemfile. Uses external ExifTool/dependencies when executed.

rows.name: crunch
rows.note: Debian-maintained complete Crunch source, linked by Kali. Avoids an unverified GitHub mirror. Reviewed generator and Makefile.

rows.name: hashcat
rows.note: Offline password/hash audit tool. Wallet/hash formats in source are expected input-format support. Reviewed main entrypoint, build files and license.

rows.name: hydra (auth brute)
rows.note: Official THC authentication assessment source; reviewed configure and C entrypoint. Authentication attempts are an intentional capability, not proof of an upstream implant.

rows.name: medusa (auth brute)
rows.note: Foofus network authentication tool. This is distinct from Ch0pin/medusa already present for mobile instrumentation.

rows.name: bully
rows.note: Wireless WPS assessment source; privileged capture/transmission is intentional. Reviewed C entrypoint and Makefiles.

rows.name: hcxdumptool
rows.note: Author-maintained capture tool; reviewed C entrypoint and Makefile. Wireless frame transmission/capture requires a separately chosen operating scope.

rows.name: reaver
rows.note: Maintained Reaver/Wash fork. Reviewed C entrypoint and install/build files; no wireless operations performed.

rows.name: binwalk
rows.note: Reviewed Rust implementation and extraction helpers. Dockerfile uses a remote Rust installer; extraction invokes external programs only when explicitly run. Historical v2 extractor findings are not evidence of malicious v3 source.

rows.name: gdb + GEF/PEDA
rows.note: GDB, GEF and PEDA sources are present; no extension is loaded automatically.

rows.name: ltrace
rows.note: Canonical repository linked from ltrace.org. Reviewed source archive and build files; GitLab archive state was not reported by the API.

rows.name: strace
rows.note: Autogenerated upstream archives deliberately omit code via .gitattributes. Actual pinned Git objects were fetched and source/build/security files inspected instead.

rows.name: aws-cli
rows.note: Official AWS source. Reviewed CLI/build/install entrypoints and telemetry module: session IDs are stored locally and used with service requests; AWS_CLI_SESSION_ID_DISABLED is an opt-out. Binary installer was not run.

rows.name: fierce

rows.name: whatweb
rows.note: Reviewed Ruby entrypoint, Gemfile and Makefile. Fingerprinting plugins/data were included in the bounded text-pattern scan, not a complete plugin audit.

rows.name: nbtscan
rows.note: Maintained upstream identified in Debian/Fedora package records; reviewed NetBIOS scanner and build metadata.

rows.name: onesixtyone

rows.name: anew
rows.note: Small append/deduplication utility; reviewed main.go and module metadata.

rows.name: cdncheck
rows.note: Reviewed Go CLI/library and metadata; CDN/WAF data and dependencies are separate data-flow surfaces at runtime.

rows.name: mapcidr
rows.note: Reviewed CIDR CLI and module/build metadata. No operations against networks were performed.

rows.name: qsreplace
rows.note: Small URL query transformation utility; reviewed main.go and module metadata.

rows.name: shuffledns
rows.note: Reviewed Go CLI/module metadata. Wraps external massdns; this fetcher does not install or invoke it.

rows.name: John the Ripper
rows.note: Openwall John the Ripper source; password/hash extractors are intentional. Reviewed main entrypoint and build/license files; no password recovery performed.

rows.name: Evil-WinRM (Ruby)
rows.note: Ruby variant, separate from Python client. Three embedded Base64 PowerShell loaders were decoded as text for inspection, never executed; their remote loading features are documented.

rows.name: PowerShell
rows.note: Selected-file review of large Microsoft toolchain. Install script downloads additional platform scripts; it was inspected as text and not executed. Full source-pattern scan was not performed.

rows.name: wifite
rows.note: Reviewed wireless orchestration entrypoint/config/packaging. Starts external wireless assessment tools only at runtime; none were invoked.

rows.name: pixiewps
rows.note: Reviewed WPS calculation C entrypoint and Makefile; analysis is intended offline WPS functionality.

rows.name: Proxychains / Proxychains4
rows.note: Reviewed launcher, preload library and installer. LD_PRELOAD socket interception is an intentional proxy function, not a hidden persistence mechanism.

rows.name: Socat
rows.note: Complete Debian source package: descriptor, upstream archive and Debian patches. Every recorded SHA-256 matched. Descriptor signature was not cryptographically verified; no archive is extracted by the fetcher.

rows.name: nc / netcat
rows.note: Debian source for OpenBSD netcat; reviewed C entrypoint/Makefile. Inventory did not establish which nc alternative is selected in the VM.

rows.name: Tor
rows.note: Tor Project GitLab.com mirror. Canonical Tor-hosted GitLab was unavailable here; mirror identity is disclosed. Reviewed source/build entrypoint, not anonymity guarantees.

rows.name: torsocks
rows.note: Debian privacy-team source with upstream identity in configure metadata. Reviewed preload/socket library and build scripts.

rows.name: dex2jar pomoćni alati
rows.note: Reviewed Gradle configuration, wrapper, launcher and Java command. Building can fetch Gradle/Maven dependencies; these were not installed or audited transitively.

rows.name: GCC
rows.note: Read-only GCC mirror; selected build/compiler files reviewed. Prerequisite downloader uses gcc.gnu.org and defaults to SHA-512 integrity checks. Full compiler codebase was not audited.

rows.name: Go
rows.note: Selected-file review of official Go toolchain. go.env defaults to the Go proxy/checksum service and automatic toolchain download. These operations were not run; full source scan was not performed.

rows.name: objdump
rows.note: Canonical Sourceware repository used by GDB and GNU Binutils. Actual pinned Git objects fetched; selected build, debugger and binary-reader entrypoints inspected. Full 43k-file audit not performed.

rows.name: readelf
rows.note: Canonical Sourceware repository used by GDB and GNU Binutils. Actual pinned Git objects fetched; selected build, debugger and binary-reader entrypoints inspected. Full 43k-file audit not performed.

rows.name: strings
rows.note: Canonical Sourceware repository used by GDB and GNU Binutils. Actual pinned Git objects fetched; selected build, debugger and binary-reader entrypoints inspected. Full 43k-file audit not performed.

rows.name: Docker
rows.note: Official Docker CLI, not the daemon or Docker Desktop. Reviewed CLI/build metadata and OpenTelemetry integration; external plugins/daemon/containers are not included in this source review.

rows.name: OpenSSL
rows.note: Official library/CLI source. Reviewed build configuration, CLI entrypoint and license; broad text scan is not a cryptographic or parser correctness audit.

rows.name: curl
rows.note: curl je katalogizovan; crt.sh je spoljašnji servis korišćen u prečici.

rows.name: wget
rows.note: Debian-maintained GNU Wget source; reviewed configure and source snapshot. This is a downstream source, not a claim of exact VM version equivalence.

rows.name: dig
rows.note: Canonical ISC GitLab source including dig and host. Reviewed both command entrypoints and package/build metadata.

rows.name: host
rows.note: Canonical ISC GitLab source including dig and host. Reviewed both command entrypoints and package/build metadata.

rows.name: whois
rows.note: Maintainer WHOIS source; reviewed client and Makefile. Queries disclose supplied names to selected WHOIS servers by design.

rows.name: traceroute
rows.note: Complete Debian source package: descriptor, upstream archive and Debian patches. Every recorded SHA-256 matched. Descriptor signature was not cryptographically verified; no archive is extracted by the fetcher.
